case.nameZh: CIVIC ACCESS｜公共服務數位申辦系統設計
case.nameEn: CIVIC ACCESS｜Public Service Experience & Application System
case.themeZh: 讓公共服務，更容易被理解與完成。
case.scopeZh: 服務設計／品牌識別／數位平台 UI/UX／無障礙設計／紙本與空間導視
case.scopeEn: Service Design / Visual Identity / Digital Service UI/UX / Accessibility / Print & Wayfinding
case.disclaimerZh: CIVIC ACCESS 為公共服務體驗設計案例，非政府官方申辦入口。示範資格、文件與案件狀態不具行政效力；互動原型不收集真實個人資料。
case.disclaimerEn: CIVIC ACCESS is a service-design portfolio project, not an official government application portal. Eligibility rules, document requirements and case statuses are illustrative. The prototype must not collect real personal information.

shots.captionZh: 展示品牌識別、數位入口與公共服務接觸點的整體設計方向。
shots.captionEn: A unified service identity across digital and physical touchpoints.

shots.captionZh: 以藍色幾何識別、字體階層與服務圖示建立可延伸的品牌系統。
shots.captionEn: A flexible identity system with geometric symbolism and clear typography.

shots.captionZh: 以服務中心情境說明櫃檯、導視及輔助服務的視覺應用。
shots.captionEn: Environmental applications for guidance and assisted access.

shots.captionZh: 以紙本手冊、文件清單與表單排版呈現公共服務接觸點之編輯系統概念模擬（尚未打樣）。
shots.captionEn: Printed editorial system concept simulation for public service touchpoints (pre-sampling prototype).
shots.source: 攝影式數位概念模擬（未實際打樣）

shots.captionZh: 示範現場服務機台的入口分類、協助方式與操作目的。
shots.captionEn: An illustrative kiosk environment for on-site service discovery.

shots.captionZh: 以長者、家庭照顧者及輔助科技使用者的假設需求規劃服務。
shots.captionEn: Scenario-based design considerations across different access needs.

shots.captionZh: 用可編輯 HTML/CSS 呈現搜尋、分類與申辦指南資訊架構。
shots.captionEn: Browser-rendered desktop interface for service search and discovery.

shots.captionZh: 將服務探索、指南與身分選擇分成三種清楚的手機操作狀態。
shots.captionEn: Three distinct mobile states, designed around one task at a time.

shots.captionZh: 對照民眾、平台及服務人員三個角色的五階段協作流程。
shots.captionEn: A multi-actor blueprint linking citizen, platform and staff workflows.

shots.captionZh: 以不同辦理身分切換示範規則與文件清單。
shots.captionEn: Conditional guidance based on sample applicant scenarios.

shots.captionZh: 呈現本人與代辦在已準備、待準備及缺件狀態的差異。
shots.captionEn: Readiness states across applicant and representative scenarios.

shots.captionZh: 展示欄位群組、必填提示、返回修改及操作說明。
shots.captionEn: Structured form stages with guidance and recoverable navigation.

shots.captionZh: 同一欄位呈現需要修改與修正完成兩種不同狀態。
shots.captionEn: Paired validation and corrected states with explicit guidance.

shots.captionZh: 呈現選檔、格式檢查、缺件與返回補件。
shots.captionEn: Distinct file selection, validation and review states.

shots.captionZh: 用示範編號與進度時間軸說明確認與狀態追蹤。
shots.captionEn: Illustrative confirmation and tracking with an explicitly demo-only ID.

shots.captionZh: 列出對比、鍵盤焦點、語意及狀態提示的實測要求。
shots.captionEn: Testing requirements for contrast, keyboard focus, semantics and status updates.

services.titleZh: 社區資源生活補助示範諮詢
services.descZh: 提供基礎生活補助申請指引、資格前置試算說明與文件準備清單。
services.descEn: Guided application for basic community assistance, scenario evaluation, and document readiness checklist.

services.titleZh: 輔助器具與無障礙生活支持
services.descZh: 評估生活輔助器具補助項目，提供居家無障礙改善指引與身分證明備妥指引。
services.descEn: Evaluation of assistive devices and home barrier-free modification subsidies with document guides.

services.titleZh: 居家照顧與日間喘息服務諮詢
services.descZh: 協助家庭照顧者規劃居服員到府服務、社區關懷據點及日照中心銜接。
services.descEn: Assisting family caregivers in arranging home care visits, community centers, and day-care coordination.

services.titleZh: 高齡友善餐飲與健康促進服務
services.descZh: 結合鄰里送餐服務、長者共餐據點與定期健康講座之申辦預約。
services.descEn: Coordination of neighborhood meal deliveries, senior meal centers, and community health events.

services.titleZh: 跨局處綜合申辦證明文件諮詢
services.descZh: 釐清不同戶籍、親屬委任及代辦人之必要法定證明文件格式與印鑑要求。
services.descEn: Clarifying document formats, representative power-of-attorney, and identification across offices.

applicant.descZh: 國民身分證正面／反面影本或居留證等有效證件。
applicant.descEn: National ID card or resident certificate copy.

applicant.descZh: 生活補助或資源需求項目簡述，可使用線上範本填寫。
applicant.descEn: Brief summary of assistance needed, fillable via online template.

representative.descZh: 國民身分證正面／反面影本或居留證等有效證件。
representative.descEn: National ID card or resident certificate copy.

representative.descZh: 生活補助或資源需求項目簡述，可使用線上範本填寫。
representative.descEn: Brief summary of assistance needed, fillable via online template.

representative.titleZh: 代辦委託書與受任人身分證件
representative.descZh: 委任代辦授權簽署書及受任人本人有效身分證明文件。
representative.descEn: Signed power-of-attorney form and agent's valid ID proof.
